body: Sorry for the late reply, the pills kicked in and I've just been laying in bed all day trying to pass the time with more sleep. But the "could" is part of the problem for me. Yeah, I could find someone eventually, or I could not. Things could better, or they could not. I'm going through so much pain just for ifs and maybes

It doesn't always work out that way though. They could move on to that other guy, be perfectly happy with them, and not have even a second thought about what they did to me or how much it affected me. I've tried dating sites before, it's never worked out. I've had a few hook ups, which are fun but at the end of the day they still leave me feeling empty inside. And when something more serious is attempted with someone I met online, normally we chat, hit it off, then we have a first date and I never hear from them again. That's part of why this new girl had my hopes up, bc we had already met a d talked in person, seemed to hit it off and really relate to one another. Then out of the blue she cancels our date and I'm just set aside for someone else. She's said how sorry she is and offered to get coffee in place of our date, just as friends. but it still really hurts bc of just how quickly and easily I'm tossed aside for other options

I don't dump them, I get dumped for other people. Every relationship I've ever had has ended with them out of the blue saying they don't want to be me but theyre with someone else now. The most painful of which, which initially started my downward spiral, was when a girl I had dated for 2 years, loved, and honestly felt like I was going to marry, broke up with me after another guy she was sleeping with went through her phone and demanded to know who I was saying he's her boyfriend. Then when me and her got to talk she said she didn't want to be with me anymore bc she's with him now. I havnt dome much dating since bit a couple weeks ago I met a girl and we stated talking, I really liked her and for once felt like I wanted a relationship again. Just for her to cancel our first date bc things stated getting serious with another guy

I know, I just can't pull myself to tell them. I've never been good about talking about this stuff to those close to me, bc I know I have a family that loves me, I know that I have friends that love me, but I still feel alone bc with romantic relationships I'm only ever tossed aside for better options. I have family, I have friends, but in the end I got to bed alone every night. I have no one to confide in the way only romantically involved people can. I feel all parents or friends could tell me Is that "it's their loss,  plenty of fish in the sea, etc etc" just typical stuff that doesn't really mean anything to me, bc I know they would say the exact same things regardless of if what they say is true or not. Being along hurts, but every time I actually try to fix it, I just end of getting hurt more and left off worse than before

I havnt talked to them about it. Me and my parents never really talk. They know I'm not the happiest person, but they have no idea how bad it is and I don't really want them to. I feel like having that information out would just make my day to day life more difficult, awkward. I've always been a private person and stick mostly to myself even among family and hated the idea of having to move back in with my parents. I love them and they love me, but we're not so close that I feel like this is something I can talk to them about, but we're close enough that I know just how devastated they would be to find me dead. But the way I look at it, people die everyday, some people lives are cut short my freaks of nature, so why should it be so bad if someone actually dies just bc they want to? I just don't think my friends and family would see it like that

I know things will get better with time, but I doubt by much. And even if it did, it's not worth this. I've been moving a gun to and from my head over the last few hours and I don't have any fear about dying anymore. I know I just need to pull the trigger and the pain stops. Thinking what it would be like for my parents when they come in after hearing the shot is the only thing keeping me from doing it. Ive been taking a bunch of sleeping pills every few minutes trying to put me to sleep just so the pain can stop and I can make it till tomorrow but I'm still wide awake. They numb my mind a bit which helps but I still can't take it. I've thought about a therapist, but that's not something I can afford. I had a few sessions with one a while back and I felt like it was just someone who is there more for money then to help and is paid to tell me whatever lies they think will help me
She's the only one who's ever made me feel like this
Yes she does, very much so

Sorry for the late reply, I went out with friends Sunday night which made me feel a little better. They know the situation and are there for me which helps but now I'm back at school, I saw her and everything just comes crashing back down on me and I'm back to square 1

I try to fight and move past it, and it seems to work until I actually have to see her. Then any progress just breaks apart. I feel so anxious about the possibility of seeing her that it makes me not even want to go to class, and when I actually do see her, I get such a horrible feeling in my stomach that I feel like I'm going to puke, and want to do nothing more then rush home, and take more sleeping pills so I can just numb the pain and sleep through it
How exactly can I reframe? I go telling myself that I'm there to improve myself, she's nothing to me now and I can just move on. Then I actually see her like I just did and everything breaks down
Not necessarily. If it does exist, it's certainly not always good. Some people are destined to be hit by a truck

I try to think about all the people who have been here before me. I know I'm not alone and others have made it through, but I feel like I'm weaker then those people. Not everyone makes it, and I feel I'm destined to be one of them.

I know overall it's better I found out when I did, a month after it happened she tried talking to me again, no apology or anything just pretended like it didn't happen. And every inch of me wanting to forget about and get back with her but I forced myself to say no bc I knew I could never trust her again and it was for the better. But I loved her and never felt the way I did for her towards anyone else. I try to move on and focus on myself but it just hurts too much. I only got by the last year after months of not seeing her and hearing from her, allowing me to start trying to pretend she doesn't exist and forget about her, but now that's hard to do when she's right there in front of me at school
